name: Upstart Goblin
text: Draw 1 card, then your opponent gains 1000 LP.

name: Guide example — then
text: Special Summon 1 monster from your hand, then end the Battle Phase.

name: Guide example — also
text: Return 1 Spell/Trap on the field to the hand, also draw 1 card.

name: Guide example — and if you do
text: Take 1000 damage, and if you do, destroy 1 card on the field.
